text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has finally arrived! And as we're pumping ourselves up to meet our end-of-summer goals…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! We've reached the summer camp facilities at long last. How I've waited for this day.
choice_data_list: You sure look happy to be here.
You sure look happy to be here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, my condition almost always keeps me from participating in summer camp activities to the degree I'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You've worked tirelessly to bolster my muscles, Trainer, and I intend to commit myself just as tirelessly to getting the most out of this camp experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such, Trainer, I ask that you push me to my very limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, my blazing-hot summer camp experience with Mejiro Ardan is underway!
